scope: Resolve the three outer top-right pixels of the normal GTK2 vertical upper stepper using a palette-derived ACTIVE trough underlay, without changing the horizontal result

reference.registration: R325 measured bounds x=13..27, y=16..30 in the live File Manager capture. The GTK2 native probe's corresponding cell begins at y=2.

implementation.design: Generate a separate vertical ACTIVE trough image from the current KDE-rendered trough, copy three corner samples from the normal up-stepper generated from the same KDE roles, and use a vertical 9-slice with four preserved rows at the top and bottom.
implementation.color_policy: No final RGB values are embedded; every copied pixel comes from the same palette-rendered GTK2 stepper asset.

generated_preview.generator: prepare_domainos rendered the actual repository source for the current KDE GTK palette and loaded the generated RC with GTK2 2.24.33 under private Xvfb.

comparison.down_stepper: Not changed. The retained R325 lower-arrow crop has an unresolved first-row registration mismatch; a fresh aligned Domain/OS pair is still required before editing this glyph.

limits: Only the normal vertical upper stepper's three outer pixels are resolved by this comparison.
The lower vertical arrow, held/hover/disabled states, the in-application GTK2 session and human visual review remain open.
The user's profile and applications were not changed or restarted; no input was sent to any MAME instance.
next: Continue only GTK2/I167 by obtaining a reliably registered normal lower-arrow reference, then validate remaining states and the actual application preview.
